e.title: insurance-conformal-ts
e.summary: 时序 conformal（burning-cost，PyPI 0.2.0）：非可交换索赔时间序列的 conformal 区间
e.summary_en: Time-series conformal (burning-cost, PyPI 0.2.0): conformal intervals for non-exchangeable claims time series
e.summary_hk: 時序 conformal（burning-cost，PyPI 0.2.0）：非可交換索賠時間序列的 conformal 區間
e.body: insurance-conformal-ts（burning-cost，PyPI v0.2.0）做非可交换（non-exchangeable）保险索赔时间序列的 conformal 预测区间：ACK/Aggregate Conformal——数据分布随时间变化时的覆盖保证。对 RIAA：保险数据是时序的（分布漂移）——标准 conformal 假设可交换性，本包处理非可交换场景（[[insurance-conformal]] 的时序分支）；与 [[insurance-monitoring]]（漂移检测）、[[insurance-changepoint]]（变点）配套；适合准备金/定价的时序预测区间。
e.body_en: insurance-conformal-ts (burning-cost, PyPI v0.2.0) does conformal prediction intervals for non-exchangeable insurance claims time series: ACK/Aggregate Conformal — coverage guarantees when the data distribution shifts over time. For RIAA: insurance data is time-ordered (distributions drift) — standard conformal assumes exchangeability, this package handles non-exchangeable settings (the time-series branch of [[insurance-conformal]]); pairs with [[insurance-monitoring]] (drift) and [[insurance-changepoint]] (change points); suits time-series prediction intervals for reserving/pricing.
e.body_hk: insurance-conformal-ts（burning-cost，PyPI v0.2.0）做非可交換（non-exchangeable）保險索賠時間序列的 conformal 預測區間：ACK/Aggregate Conformal——數據分佈隨時間變化時的覆蓋保證。對 RIAA：保險數據是時序的（分佈漂移）——標準 conformal 假設可交換性，本包處理非可交換場景（[[insurance-conformal]] 的時序分支）；與 [[insurance-monitoring]]（漂移檢測）、[[insurance-changepoint]]（變點）配套；適合準備金/定價的時序預測區間。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：PyPI v0.2.0 + GitHub README（家族成员），未实测
